title: Separate state layers instead of using one global store

contextSnapshot.surface: collaborative issue tracker and analytics workspace

prompt: Architect the frontend state layers for our Next.js issue tracker (filters, API data with optimistic updates, sidebar UI, multi-step upload workflow, and offline drafts).
forbiddenBehaviors: puts API cache, URL filters, and local UI toggles into one global Redux or Zustand store
uses a global module-level Zustand singleton during SSR without per-request isolation
stores megabytes of offline drafts synchronously in localStorage

rubricDimensions.pass: assigns URL filters, server cache, client UI, workflow state, and offline storage to distinct appropriate layers
rubricDimensions.fail: collapses all state into a single global store

rubricDimensions.pass: cancels in-flight queries, snapshots previous cache, rolls back on error, and invalidates on settled
rubricDimensions.fail: mutates cache without cancelQueries or rollback path

rubricDimensions.pass: isolates client stores per request in SSR and uses IndexedDB/Dexie with versioned upgrades for offline drafts
rubricDimensions.fail: leaks singleton store across SSR requests or puts large drafts in localStorage

negativeControls.name: server data in zustand
negativeControls.input: fetch issues in useEffect and store them in a global Zustand slice
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend manual useEffect + global store caching over server-state cache libraries

negativeControls.name: dexie version edit
negativeControls.input: modify an already-shipped Dexie db.version(1).upgrade callback in place
negativeControls.mustNot: approve mutating a shipped version with an upgrader instead of adding version(2)

baseline.withoutSkill: dumps API entities, URL filters, and UI toggles into one global store and overlooks SSR singleton leaks
baseline.withSkill: partitions state across URL (nuqs), server cache (TanStack Query), per-request client store (Zustand), workflow (XState v5), and IndexedDB (Dexie)
